title: Contextual inline editing

story.need: select rendered content and edit it without leaving the website
story.outcome: maintain content in context while preserving draft and publication safety

scope: Show editing affordances only to authenticated editors
Select a rendered block by pointer or keyboard
Edit block fields in a non-obstructive contextual panel
Save through the shared draft command
Preview and explicitly publish the current draft
dataRequirements: Rendered blocks expose stable content, revision, block, and field identifiers
Inline saves record inline as their actor source
The public revision remains unchanged until explicit publish
permissions: Anonymous users receive no editing controls or draft data
Authenticated site owners may edit and publish

then: no editor controls or draft values are delivered

acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated editor viewing a published page
then: its fields open in a dismissible contextual panel

acceptanceCriteria.given: an inline edit to a published page
then: a new draft revision is created with inline source
anonymous visitors still receive the prior publication
the panel explains how to refresh without losing the attempted value
